body: People increasingly use frontier AI models for health advice, but via different access modes (e.g., ChatGPT, ChatGPT Health, APIs) with varying settings. Here, we find systematic differences across access modes. Because evaluations typically rely on APIs while consumers interact through chatbot interfaces, these discrepancies limit evaluation validity. Our findings underscore an urgent need for model providers to enable faithful replication of consumer experiences and settings for rigorous audits.
summaryZh: 研究发现，大模型在不同访问模式（如API与聊天机器人界面）下存在系统性的输出差异。由于目前的评估工作多依赖API，而消费者实际使用聊天界面，这种差异限制了评估结果的有效性。文章呼吁模型提供商应支持对消费者体验和设置的忠实复现，以确保在医疗等关键领域进行更严谨的审计。
